body: As I stand there, the sand swaying beneath my feet, I notice the line of shells stretching far beyond my reach, their vibrant blue glinting in the sunlight. It's as if someone has been playing a prank, leaving behind a mysterious trail of shells. My first thought is to call out to the tide, to demand an explanation for this strange occurrence.
